gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.title: Smart troubleshooting
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.scope: Scope: current root and captured client data. Confirm the intended recipe and output in JEI first.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.index_: [Info] The recipe index required by this network is ready.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.pendin: [Pending] Recipe data is still loading. Missing recipes or wrong outputs cannot be confirmed yet; refresh later.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.root_o: [Pass] The root resource exactly matches the order target.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.root_u: [Check] The root is not built yet, or differs from the order target.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.jei_un: [Check] No JEI runtime found. If using EMI, check its categories; otherwise verify that JEI is installed and ready.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.catego: [Suspect] Network types absent from current JEI/EMI categories: %s. Aliases, hidden categories or missing compatibility may explain this. Include category screenshots; absence alone is not proof.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.captur: [Error] JEI capture failures this session (category=count): %s. Include latest.log around Unable to index JEI recipe.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.no_rec: [Action] No root recipe selected. Right-click root to check candidates and saved no-recipe preferences. If JEI shows a recipe with no candidates, report its category and screenshot.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.exact: [Pass] The captured output exactly matches target NBT/components. This verifies only the preview.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.ambigu: [Error] Multiple same-resource component variants exist for this recipe, none exact. A safe choice is impossible; select a specific JEI variant and report it.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.compon: [Difference] Same resource, different NBT/components. Review fields below and explicitly select a candidate if intended. Dynamic outputs still require execution checks.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.wrong_: [Error] The current resource index has no same-resource output for this root recipe. Capture, output mapping or recipe selection may be wrong; check the JEI output.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.family: [Action] This network has not enabled the root recipe type. Check provisioner types and machine bindings.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.not_ex: [Error] This native recipe has no supported execution path. Check JEI capture or ask developers to verify native fallback; adding a type name alone cannot fix this.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.profil: [Info] Matching I/O profiles: %s (at most 8 listed). No profile does not imply incompatibility.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.virtua: [Advice] This root comes from a JEI/EMI layout. For missing inputs/byproducts, report category, complete layout and input groups. No I/O template is generated for proxy classes.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.diff_l: Field differences (read-only; at most 16; each side limited to 128 leaves/32 levels/8192 characters and 256 characters per value; may be truncated):
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.diff_u: [Check] The bounded projection cannot explain the identity difference, possibly due to encoding failure or truncation. Do not ignore NBT on this evidence.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.candid: [Info] Same-resource candidates on this network: %s (at most 4 with field differences). A candidate does not authorize automatic substitution.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.dynami: [Limit] A static preview cannot predict dynamic results or verify machine slots, filters and live inventory. Troubleshooting never relaxes global NBT/component equality.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.feedba: Developer feedback: copy this report; add expected root recipe/output, observed behavior, target and JEI screenshots, relevant mod versions, and [NBT-ORDER]/JEI error excerpts from latest.log. Exclude unrelated personal information.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.profil: This is an incomplete I/O template for developer review, not a fix. Verify source fields and recipe_id_prefixes scope before filling input_fields/output_fields. Install under data/<namespace>/recipe_io_profiles/<name>.json in a datapack and reload. Component differences alone do not justify ignoring NBT.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.incomp: [Incomplete] Failed to read diagnostic data: %s. Report this and the corresponding log.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.generi: [Clue] All inputs use the generic ingredients group. This may be correct. If the machine needs separate tool, container or catalyst slots, report those slots and the category ID for a data/<namespace>/jei_input_group_profiles/*.json review; unnamed slots cannot be safely guessed.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.proble: Problem: the root recipe or output differs from what I want.
Problem: a JEI category I want is absent from root candidates.
Problem: same item ID, unexpected NBT/components.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.choose: Choose a problem. For recipe issues supply a sample and expected type/recipe. Cannot order inspects planning; stalled execution requires a selected order in status.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.item_h: Drop a JEI resource to preserve NBT/components, or enter namespace:item. Empty uses the current sample. A different item ID uses default components, not a particular variant.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.expect: For category problems enter namespace:category; otherwise optionally enter namespace:recipe. Entry recipe information is prefilled where available. Edit and run again.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.run_pr: Complete the fields, then click Run checks.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.invali: [Input error] Unknown item: %s. Enter a valid item ID or drop a JEI sample.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.plain_: [Input] This item ID uses default components. Drop an exact JEI sample to diagnose a specific NBT/component variant.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.root_m: [Difference] The current root resource identity differs from the requested sample.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.expect: [More input] No expected recipe/category provided. Resource checks are available, but the intended recipe cannot be inferred.
[Located] Expected category absent from current JEI/EMI metadata. Check the ID, viewer loading and mod integration. An alias or metadata capture error may also explain this.
[Located] This network has not enabled the expected category. Select its provisioner type and check machine bindings.

[Located] Category exists and is enabled, but the captured catalog has no same-resource output for this target. Report its JEI layout, category ID and logs to review capture/I/O profiles. This does not prove JEI has no recipe.
[Located] The captured catalog contains same-resource outputs in the expected category; candidate IDs follow. Check saved preferences or explicitly choose a candidate if root differs.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.root_c: [Difference] Root category is %s; expected %s. Checks do not replace the current selection.
[Pass] Root category matches the stated expectation.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.expect: [Located] The expected category has same-resource candidates but no component-exact output. Use NBT checks or drop the correct variant.
[Located] The captured target-resource bucket has no expected recipe. Check its ID, target, category loading and enabled types; include a JEI screenshot when reporting.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.root_r: [Pass] Root recipe ID matches the stated expectation.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.profil: [Advice] This root differs from the expected recipe/category, or its target output has not been captured. Its profile template is withheld; report the expected category/recipe to avoid editing the wrong compatibility rule.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.enable_ty: Action: If this recipe has no available executor/type is disabled, bind a compatible machine to this network with the network connector and enable its recipe type; or enable the type in a bound provisioner (search its manual type selector when available), then configure input groups and delivery. Reopen the tree to verify. Enabling a type alone does not make a machine process it.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.furnace: Action: Add the required BD network furnace, blast furnace or smoker to this network; check the network and availability of existing devices.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.assign_gr: Action: Use the input-group name in the status below. Open machine/provisioner configuration and assign that group for this recipe type. Ensure every group has an endpoint.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.provision: Action: Free provisioner space by removing unrelated or backed-up resources. Check its delivery path and watch whether the order resumes.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.network_s: Action: Free or expand network storage and check resource storage limits so outputs/reserved returns can fit. Wait for the automatic retry; avoid repeated cancel/resubmit attempts.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.blocking: Action: Blocking mode is waiting for old recipe inputs to clear. Check remaining inputs and processing conditions, remove unintended leftovers, then observe. Do not blindly disable blocking mode.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.clear_out: Action: Clear existing machine outputs/byproducts and check output sides and collection paths, then observe the order.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.restore_b: Action: Check for removed/unbound devices or changed types/input groups and restore the intended configuration. Failed orders do not resume automatically; account for delivered materials and outputs before resubmitting.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.materials: Action: Supply the missing/waited resources shown below. Check exact components/NBT, input groups and endpoint filters. Check earlier orders if stock is reserved elsewhere; equal counts with different components do not satisfy the requirement.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.provision: Checks: The provisioner path has not collected enough output. Check input delivery, machine recipe/energy/conditions, return to this network, then exact output components/NBT. This status does not identify which check failed.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.machine_o: Checks: The machine path has not collected enough output. Check input delivery, energy/processing conditions, output/byproduct slots, collection path and exact output components. “Processing” does not prove the machine is actually running.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.dependenc: Action: Inspect earlier orders and prerequisite steps. Wait for occupied devices; if progress stops, diagnose the blocking order first. Avoid duplicate orders merely because this one is queued.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.shared_io: Action: Generic machine execution cannot handle the same resource as both input and output. Use a provisioner with external automation, or dedicated compatibility. Rebinding alone cannot fix this.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.compatibi: Compatibility check: Recipe unavailable, unsupported structure or simulation failure. Reopen the tree to confirm it still exists. If persistent, report recipe ID, full layout and logs; verify server mods/datapacks and I/O profiles. Do not install an empty template.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.output_mi: Action: Compare actual and expected output components/NBT. Drag an exact sample into component diagnostics and specify the recipe ID. Verify actual dynamic output first; do not globally ignore components.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.working: Observe: The executor is feeding, preparing or waiting for a crafting interval. Refresh to watch the next stage; if unchanged, check device input capability, sides, filters and slots.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.filter: Action: An endpoint filter blocked a resource. Check the machine/provisioner whitelist, blacklist and exact component rules for the input side, allow the required resource, then observe.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.network: Action: Verify that the network exists, is connected and you have access. Restore network/access and reopen the screen.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.delivery: Action: Check final delivery using the status below: owner online and inventory space; a valid dashboard-back container with space; use network delivery for resources unsupported by player inventory. Account for already-delivered materials before resubmitting.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.final_out: Checks: Steps ended but final output has not reached the network. Check collection, capacity, filters and exact output components.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.dynamic: Action: Actual dynamic output differs from the stocking target. Check the real output and update the target sample, or use a manual order. Do not relax global component matching.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.complete: Result: Order completed. Check its selected destination: network, player inventory or dashboard-back container.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.cancelled: Result: Order cancelled and will not continue. Cancellation does not retrieve materials already sent to machines; check those materials and outputs before resubmitting.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.unknown: Not localized: Current evidence is insufficient. Keep the state/error below and refresh to check for changes. If persistent, copy the report with device configuration, full recipe and logs.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.ready: Result: The preview is ready; return to submit. Preserve any subsequent server error in chat. Preview readiness does not guarantee submission success.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.loading: Action: Indexing/planning is in progress. Wait for the loading phase below, then diagnose again. Check logs if it stops advancing; missing candidates during loading do not prove incompatibility.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.no_recipe: Action: No usable plan. Check network type bindings under missing-category diagnostics, then inspect component variants and explicitly select a recipe. Report compatibility only after the catalog is ready.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.cycle: Action: Candidate routes form a cycle. Choose another recipe at the cyclic node or provide its base material in the network, then replan.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.budget: Action: Planning or transfer limit reached; this does not prove no solution. Reduce quantity, explicitly choose complex-node recipes or provide intermediate stock, then retry. Report the tree if persistent.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.stale: Action: Stock/recipe snapshot changed. Wait for revalidation or reopen the tree from the network; retry with less concurrent material consumption.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.queue_lim: Action: Wait for submission cooldown or active orders to finish, then submit once. Check active orders to avoid duplicates.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.open_stat: Next: Open order diagnostics, select the stalled order and click Troubleshoot. Execution issues require that order’s server state, not just this tree.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.verify_su: Verify: Return to the tree, wait for revalidation and check submission. This is a click-time snapshot; run again after planning changes or new submission errors. The last rejection is retained until the next submission or closing the screen.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.verify_ex: Verify: This page updates with order status; scroll for more. After acting, watch the reason, steps and collected quantity. Machine energy/slots and the world are not inspected; checks remain unverified.
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.status_un: Waiting: Selected order state unavailable. Refresh or return and reselect the order; no execution conclusion is possible yet.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.proble: Cannot order: advice from current planning, server preview errors and missing materials.
Stalled execution: diagnose the selected order using its server-side reason.
gui.beyond_craftlines.diagnostics.contex: Unfinished step sample (up to 4; parallel steps may not share the reason above):
gui.beyond_craftlines.solution.refresh: Action: Preview transfer or target validation failed. Reopen the recipe tree from the network and wait for complete loading and server validation. If persistent, verify matching client/server versions and report the error and logs.
